wildwalker.desc: While you have Boon of the Bear active, Wildclaw will now strike an additional time for 40% of the damage dealt with both weapons.

wildwalker.name: Torn to Shreds
wildwalker.desc: Totemic Smash and Rylak's Bite now causes enemies to bleed for AP over 12 seconds, stacking 2 times.

wildwalker.name: Rexxar's Might
wildwalker.desc: Your physical critical strikes now cause your pet's next attack to apply a bleed, dealing AP Physical damage every 2 sec for 6 seconds.

wildwalker.name: Wild At Heart
wildwalker.desc: Reduces the global cooldown of Wildclaw by sec.

wildwalker.name: Throat Clamp
wildwalker.desc: Command your pet to dash forward a short distance towards your target, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 3 seconds.

wildwalker.name: Primal Shred
wildwalker.desc: Command your pet to shred up to 5 enemies within 8 yds, causing them to bleed, dealing AP Physical damage over 21 seconds.

wildwalker.name: Rush of the Hunt
wildwalker.desc: Increases the damage of Wildclaw and Rylak's Bite by 15% against bleeding enemies.

wildwalker.name: Pulverize
wildwalker.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of Totemic Smash by 10%. (up to 2 ranks)

wildwalker.name: Bestial Wrath
wildwalker.desc: When you critically strike, your pet restores 10 Focus. When your pet critically strikes, you restore 2% maximum mana and increase the target's Physical damage taken by 4% for 10 seconds.

wildwalker.name: Raptor Talons
wildwalker.desc: Increases your Strength by 5% and your expertise by 4. (up to 2 ranks)

wildwalker.name: Fury of the Wild
wildwalker.desc: When you cast a Boon, you cast the same Boon on your pet at 50% effectiveness.

wildwalker.name: Savage Frenzy
wildwalker.desc: Enrage you and your pet for 18 seconds, increasing damage dealt by 20%, and attack speed and movement speed by 30%.

wildwalker.name: Elemental Berserker
wildwalker.desc: Increases the area damage dealt by Totemic Smash by 30%, but it now costs 5 additional Rage.

wildwalker.name: Tremors
wildwalker.desc: Level 30 PassivePeriodic damage now has a 10% chance to reset the cooldown of your Seismic abilties and cause your next cast within 10 seconds to be free of cost.

wildwalker.name: Primal Weapons
wildwalker.desc: (see builder tooltip)

wildwalker.name: Spirit Stable
wildwalker.desc: Call forth a stabled animal spirit to replace your current one. Lasts 10 seconds.

wildwalker.name: Empowered Boons
wildwalker.desc: (see builder tooltip)

wildwalker.name: Killer's Path
wildwalker.desc: Increases the attack power of party and raid members by 5%. Does not stack with similar effects.In addition, increases your critical strike chance by 3%.

wildwalker.name: Pulverize
wildwalker.desc: Critical strikes with Totemic Smash now trigger the area of effect portion of its damage an additional time.

wildwalker.name: Lacerations
wildwalker.desc: Melee critical strikes now increase the effectiveness of bleed effects on the target by 30% for 15 seconds.Does not stack with similar effects.

wildwalker.name: Earthshaker
wildwalker.desc: Increases the damage dealt by Seismic abilities by 10% and allows their periodic damage to critically strike.

wildwalker.name: Wild Rampage
wildwalker.desc: Increases your attack power by 5% and your chance to hit by 2%. (up to 2 ranks)

wildwalker.name: Totemic Smash
wildwalker.desc: Smash an enemy for 140% Weapon Damage plus 20.Deals an additional AP damage to up to 5 enemies within 8 yds.

wildwalker.name: Legacy of Rexxar
wildwalker.desc: (see builder tooltip)

wildwalker.name: Rylak's Bite
wildwalker.desc: 2 Charges, 10 sec rechargeYou and your pet rush towards an enemy and strike them, dealing 120% Weapon Damage plus 8.

wildwalker.name: Totemic Echoes
wildwalker.desc: Totemic Smash now applies Totemic Crash to an enemy for 2 seconds.At the end of the duration, you are within 5 yds of the target, you cast Totemic Smash against them for free.

wildwalker.name: Bring Me Their Bones
wildwalker.desc: Mark an enemy for 15 seconds, causing damage dealt by your pet's abilities to the target to add a stack of Bring Me Their Bones.At 5 stacks, your pet consumes this buff to deal AP damage to the target, ignoring Armor.

wildwalker.name: Rylak's Blessing
wildwalker.desc: Damage dealt by Rylak's Bite now increases your pet's damage and critical strike chance by 2%, stacking 2 times, for 10 seconds.

wildwalker.name: Spiritual Frenzy
wildwalker.desc: Casting Primal Shred now empowers your pet, causing its auto attacks to strike up to 4 nearby enemies for 21 seconds.

wildwalker.name: Spinebreaker
wildwalker.desc: Your Seismic Grasp now roots enemies for 3.5 seconds.

wildwalker.name: Wild Carnage
wildwalker.desc: Seismic Spike now causes your Wildclaws to strike up to 4 additional nearby targets, dealing reduced damage with each additional enemy struck. Lasts 6 seconds.

wildwalker.name: Primal Resurgence
wildwalker.desc: Seismic Crash now generates an additional 10 Rage and Seismic Spike now generates 3 additional Rage.

wildwalker.name: Rips and Tears
wildwalker.desc: Periodic damage dealt by you or your pet now generates 2 Rage for you and 5 Focus for your pet.

wildwalker.name: Primal Rage
wildwalker.desc: Casting Totemic Smash now refreshes a charge of Rylak's Bite.

wildwalker.name: Wild Rage
wildwalker.desc: Removes the Rage cost of Rylak's Bite.

wildwalker.name: Sharpened Claws
wildwalker.desc: Your direct critical strikes now increase your and your pet's Armor penetration by 5% for 10 seconds, stacking 3 times.

wildwalker.name: Bloody Claws
wildwalker.desc: Damage dealt by your pet now reduces the enemies periodic healing received by -10% for 15 seconds, stacking 3 times.
